country.evidence_quote: We are located in Treviso, in Veneto region (Italy), 30 km far from Venice. Treviso has many interesting monuments belonging to different historical periods. Places to visit in our city: Piazza dei Signori, Palazzo dei Trecento, some churches (Duomo, Santa Maria Maggiore, San Nicolò, San Francesco, Santa Lucia), Santa Caterina Museum and Bailo Museum.
